title: Workforce Board ROI Report
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #15 (AL-07) Workforce Board ROI Report Generator into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. Computes cost-per-outcome metrics, a 5-indicator WIOA PY 2023 benchmark scorecard, a wage-vs-sector-baseline gain, a fixed-rate taxpayer tax-recapture estimate, a break-even horizon, a 3-year net benefit and return per $1, and an overall ROI grade. Sector baselines are the official BLS QCEW Q3 2023 private-sector weekly wage x52; WIOA PY 2023 target values are the Apex page values pending an official DOL ETA source (see CITES.md). Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/15-workforce-board-roi-report/ fetched 2026-10-05 (sha256 a83d547ae9788bfaabac0be084b566551f00252fe92186c45a5c929ac8c400f9), tasking APEXPORT-WF15 (GRADES abc4e16d), landed by APEX-PORT-ART712-1 on 2026-10-06.

program_name.description: Display name of the program; defaults to 'Unnamed Program' when blank.

program_type.description: WIOA Title I-B program type; selects the WIOA PY 2023 target set. Required.

program_year.description: Program year label; echoed in the report and used by the Apex page as a label only (the target set is not year-switched).

sector.description: Target sector key; selects the BLS QCEW Q3 2023 baseline annual wage. Required.

total_budget.description: Total program budget in USD; must be greater than 0. Required.

avg_training_weeks.description: Average training duration in weeks (1-104 on the Apex form); optional, display only.

participants_exited.description: Participants exited; must be >= 0. When omitted or null, defaults to participants_enrolled.

emp_rate_q2.description: Employment rate in the 2nd quarter after exit, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

emp_rate_q4.description: Employment rate in the 4th quarter after exit, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

median_earnings_q2.description: Median earnings in the 2nd quarter after exit, USD (>= 0); null when not entered.

credential_rate.description: Credential attainment rate, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

skill_gains_rate.description: Measurable skill gains rate, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads. program_type, sector, total_budget and participants_enrolled are required (validated unconditionally); every other input has a defined null/absent default in the Apex compute.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.grade_sub: Program may benefit from a strategic review
output_example.scope_note: WIOA performance targets and BLS QCEW sector baselines are inputs to this tool; the sector baselines here are the official QCEW Q3 2023 private-sector weekly wage x52, and the WIOA targets are the Apex page values pending an official DOL ETA source. Tax recapture is a fixed 30% effective-rate assumption, not a statutory rate. No PII; a pure function of the declared program inputs.
